visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A hand reaches out and turns a silver lever door handle on a dark grey door, pushing it open to reveal a brightly lit apartment interior. (2) The camera pans into a modern living room where an orange and white tabby cat is perched on a white cat tree near a large window. A man in a red shirt stands nearby filming with his phone. The cat immediately jumps down from the cat tree onto a light-colored couch. (3) The cat hops off the couch onto the light wood floor and begins trotting quickly toward the camera, its tail held high. (4) A hand enters the frame and pets the cat on the head as it arrives. The cat rubs its head against the hand and squints its eyes in contentment. (5) The cat is seen walking across the floor, then being petted repeatedly on its head and neck. It looks up at the camera with large eyes. (6) A woman in a pink shirt is crouched on the floor, filming the cat while petting it. An older man in a grey t-shirt and face mask stands next to a blue suitcase, looking at the cat. (7) The cat is shown on a bed, walking toward a person's lap. A hand pets its back. (8) Transition to a dining room where the older man (no mask) is standing at a table, using a ladle to serve soup from a pot into a small bowl. The cat walks past him on the floor. (9) Close-up of the older man as he speaks with a sad expression while continuing to serve soup. (10) The woman holds the cat in her arms close to her face. The cat opens its mouth wide in a large yawn. The woman kisses the cat's head.
